verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents outbound webhooks that notify the platform when payment, merchant, deposit or chargeback events occur. It also documents a no-code workflow that relies on Zapier, an external tool. The pack shows no in-product facility for users to define rules that automatically trigger actions on events, so webhooks are a developer building block and Zapier is a user-side workaround, and neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Rainforest utilizes webhooks to notify the platform when an event occurs
Zapier is an online tool that allows you to automate workflows without having to write any code.
You can configure a workflow to notify your support staff via email, Slack, or other apps when Rainforest sends webhooks.
